Run order: `00_GAM_survey_data.Rmd` (samples and GAM site registry) ->
`python/environmental_timeseries_pull/update_env_cache.py` with both registries ->
this script (climate and KG joins, model data).

# Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, janitor, terra, arrow)

source(here("size_bd_unified", "env_functions.R"))

bd_gam_clean = readRDS(here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", "bd_survey_gam_clean.rds"))

```

# Environmental data
```{r}
#| warning: false

# same climate cache and rolling windows as the unified pipeline (env_functions.R)
site_cells = read_site_cells(here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", "site_registry_gam_cells.csv"),
                             bd_gam_clean$site)

env_agg_all = build_env_agg(unique(site_cells$cell_id))

bd_gam_env = join_env(bd_gam_clean, site_cells, env_agg_all)

# env standardization from the unified model data, so env slopes (and the env prior built from
# m11d co100) are on the same scale. must be the data file m11d co100 was fit to
load(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_model_env_unified_2026-10-28.RData"))

unified_env_scale = list(
  precip_mean = mean(brms_data$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
  precip_sd = sd(brms_data$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
  temp_mean = mean(brms_data$temp_c_30_day_mean),
  temp_sd = sd(brms_data$temp_c_30_day_mean))

rm(brms_data)

brms_data = bd_gam_env %>%
  mutate(life_stage_simple = factor(life_stage_simple, levels = c("metamorph", "subadult", "adult")),
         is_metamorph = as.numeric(life_stage_simple == "metamorph"),
         is_not_metamorph = as.numeric(life_stage_simple != "metamorph"),
         precip_mm_10_z = (precip_mm_10_day_sum - unified_env_scale$precip_mean) / unified_env_scale$precip_sd,
         temp_c_30_z = (temp_c_30_day_mean - unified_env_scale$temp_mean) / unified_env_scale$temp_sd)

```

# KG zones
```{r}
# use the unified pipeline's site-level KG assignments (size_bd_unified/01_model_data.Rmd)
unified_sites_kg = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "size_bd_modeling_sites.csv")) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
  select(site,
         kg_id,
         kg_code_1,
         kg_code_2,
         kg_code_3)

# fallback: extract KG for any GAM sites not in the unified site table, as in the unified pipeline
kg_key = read_csv(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "legend.csv")) %>%
  select(-rgb) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) { paste0("kg_", x) })

missing_sites = brms_data %>%
  filter(!(site %in% unified_sites_kg$site)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(site_latitude = mean(site_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            site_longitude = mean(site_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

if (nrow(missing_sites) > 0) {
  kg_rast = rast(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "1991_2020", "koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif"))

  missing_sites_kg = missing_sites %>%
    bind_cols(extract(kg_rast, cbind(lon = missing_sites$site_longitude,
                                     lat = missing_sites$site_latitude))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(kg_id = koppen_geiger_0p00833333) %>%
    mutate(kg_id = if_else(kg_id == 29, 19, kg_id)) %>%
    left_join(kg_key, by = "kg_id") %>%
    select(site,
           kg_id,
           kg_code_1,
           kg_code_2,
           kg_code_3)

  unified_sites_kg = bind_rows(unified_sites_kg, missing_sites_kg)
}

missing_sites

brms_data = brms_data %>%
  left_join(unified_sites_kg, by = "site")

```

# checks
```{r}
check_na_cols = c("bd_load_co100_density",
                  "life_stage_simple",
                  "taxon_capture",
                  "svl_mm",
                  "precip_mm_10_z",
                  "temp_c_30_z",
                  "kg_code_3",
                  "population",
                  "date",
                  "year")

(na_col_check = brms_data %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(check_na_cols), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_na"))

if (sum(na_col_check$n_na) > 0) {
  print(filter(na_col_check, n_na > 0))
  stop("NAs found in model variable columns. Please review.")
}

```

# save data
```{r}
save(brms_data, file = here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", paste0("brms_data_gam_", today(), ".RData")))

```
